ActivityTimer

The 活動限界まで (active time remaining) countdown: huge red 7-segment digits on a mauve-to-navy panel, with the INTERNAL / MAIN ENERGY SUPPLY SYSTEM / EXTERNAL tabs and the STOP · SLOW · NORMAL · RACING · DANGER EMERGENCY mod
BigReadout
One huge measured value with labelled chips under it. It's the `00.000 - %` sync test (frame 203). There's also a compact map version with a Japanese/English label box (frame 109).
BracketCaption
Pipe-bracketed status lines — `| Status : Locking Down Interior Array |` — stacked in a corner over a schematic, video or graph. The most common text pattern in the Rebuild UI.
ClockBoard

Operation clocks: each row pairs a Japanese label (with an English line under it) with an amber 7-segment readout. The rows are 到達予想時刻 Estimated Time Of Breach, 到達予想時間 Estimated Time Remaining and 日本標準時 Japan Standard Ti
CommCard
The floating SOUND ONLY card that appears when a voice-only call is selected. It's a bright plate turned in 3D, with sender and recipient blocks and a LIVE tag.
ConditionPlate
The 警報 condition plate: a big 警報 / CONDITION / level block beside a short EVA status table, with six ALERT hexes around the plate. Use it for one unit's condition change.
DecryptionKey

The Decryption Key panel from the Black Chamber sequence (System Unlocked). The panel shows a lock being picked: pins resolve one at a time, and when the last one lands, every match bar snaps into a single even row.
Dialog
A modal plate over the `color-overlay` scrim, built like a Tactical Mission Notification: a blinking kicker, a big glowing title with a rule, the body, and an action row.
FieldSim
The Visualized Simulation screen from The plan. Luminous field strands sweep around a white-hot core on a near-black grid, with a lime file rail down the left edge.
FrameChrome

The AAAW interrogation-room screen frame (Rebuild 3.0+1.0). It wraps any content: corner ticks, a source label, Linked/ONLINE chips, a vertical green case label, a subject strip and a location footer.
GateSign
Physical signage: a glowing security-gate panel set into a bulkhead, and lit room-status plates on white walls.
HazardBand
The hazard family: 45° chevron bands, the EMERGENCY strip between them, short angled status tags, and the authority bar with striped end caps.
HexWall

The MAGI wall: a honeycomb of translucent red glass over a blue sky grid, with one title plate, two flanking alert cells and the three MAGI names. The wall changes state, as it does in the films. Use it for full-room ale
IdCard
Personal data cards from a records search (検索結果:個人情報). Cards stack as results come in, and the newest one is still loading its photo.
InternalTimer

The EVA-02 internal-power countdown from the Asuka clip. It's the German-locale sibling of **ActivityTimer**: the same layout (7-segment digits, three power tabs, a mode strip), but on a brick and amber housing with Germ
LiveFeed

Monitored-object video tiles: a centred `Monitored Object:` header with the object name in drawn pipes, a pilot and vitals block bottom-left, and a LIVE box with an ONLINE chip bottom-right. Tiles sit edge to edge, split
MapRadar

The impact simulation map: a polar grid seen at a tilt, with the impact column rising from its centre, shock rings spreading across the ground, coloured damage zones and white tracks out to each unit.
NotificationPlate

The Rebuild 3.0+1.0 Tactical Mission Notification: a slanted, chamfered plate with one big glowing title, a rule, two or three lines of detail and a footer bar. Use it for events the operator must read now.
PartsBlueprint

Mari's parts-list blueprint from the New Eva Parts clip. Scaffold towers in pink line art stand on a pale, greenish-white ground. Each holds one EVA component with a part code and a centred caption, and a scan bar reads
PatternScope

The pattern-simulation screen from The spears, as seen on the handheld viewer. A rough, blocky pattern forms on the centre line, then splits into three lanes: the provisional pattern, an averaged ghost and a clean sample
Reticle
Targeting overlays: the ring-and-triangle lock with its pipe-bracketed Object tag, and the plug's bracket sight with a heading tape.
RingHud
Two ring displays: the AAA Wunder's red ALERT belts, drawn in real perspective around a central shaft, and the blue external-power rings with R / L collectors.
SchematicCallout

The labels that sit on Rebuild's glowing wireframes and grid maps: a system title plate with heavy bars, region labels whose underline kinks down to a node, triangle nodes, and the `+ | Power Core` crosshair marker.
SimGrid
The EVA-02 multi-camera combat simulation from the Asuka clip. A wireframe mannequin with a rifle is seen from seven cameras across two takes. The figure moves between poses and the timecode runs.
StatusList
A system-status readout: one row per subsystem, with a glowing diamond marker, a name and a compressed state value. The rows sit in a clipped panel under a pipe-bracketed title.
StructuralDiagram

SyncGraph
Two live graphs from the sync and A.T. field screens: the sync herringbone, and the realtime sensor feed drawn as a filled contour shape.
TitleCard
Full-frame typographic cards: the white-on-black **KEEP OUT** card, and the red perspective banner that announces a new unit.
